faq.question: Which cloud do you recommend?
faq.answer: It depends on your existing commitments, regulatory requirements, and team. We are agnostic across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Cloudflare. We will recommend the right one for your workload after a short architecture review.

faq.question: Can you take over an existing cloud setup?
faq.answer: Yes. We start with a paid audit — architecture, cost, security, and reliability scorecard — then propose a phased plan. We have rescued accounts with surprise bills, manual deploys, and a single point of failure or two.

faq.question: Do you offer 24/7 on-call?
faq.answer: We do. We pair with your team during business hours and own a real on-call rotation outside it. Response times are documented up front, and we run a quarterly chaos test to keep the runbooks honest.

faq.question: How do you handle data residency in the UAE?
faq.answer: All major providers now have UAE regions, and we design for residency from the first diagram. We have shipped UAE-only deployments for healthcare, education, and government clients and can walk you through the trade-offs.
